concepts.description: A structural unit of the system that encapsulates components, types, interfaces, and functions.
A physical or logical platform that embodies robotic capabilities and interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined set of values or events used for interaction between system components.
A component responsible for managing inputs, processing logic, and coordinating actions within the system.
A basic data type predefined by the system for representing fundamental values.
A user-defined data type composed of multiple fields of primitive or other composite types.
A signal or action that can be triggered or requested, possibly with parameters and return values.
A reusable block of logic that performs a specific computation and may take inputs and return outputs.

instances.description: The main module representing the AUV system architecture.
The robotic platform component within the AUV system that uses sensor and actuator interfaces.
An interface providing access to sensor data such as depth, heading, and obstacle information.
An interface for controlling actuators; currently empty in this phase.
A controller handling operator-related inputs via the Inputs interface.
An interface defining input events such as task termination and state requests.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine functionality using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defining output events such as velocity and heading adjustments.
A controller managing autopilot functions through the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers (non-negative integers).
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing sequences of characters.
A primitive type representing true/false logical values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative position, depth, ID, and heading as a spherical vector.
An interface (note: likely typo for 'Inputs') defining input events for task control and state requests.
An event signaling the end of a task with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting OCM (possibly Operational Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting MOM (possibly Mission Operation Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting HCM (possibly Human Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting current velocity, returning a real number.
An event requesting current heading, returning a real number.
An event to advance velocity, taking a real number as parameter with no return value.
An event to advance heading, taking a real number as parameter with no return value.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical CDA values and an ID.
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
